Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Prior adjacent‑level lumbar fusion performed at least 6 months before the current request
Patient meets all criteria outlined in the applicable procedure‑specific section (either CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5) for lumbar fusion with or without decompression
Documented clinical evidence of adjacent segment pathology (e.g., radiculopathy, neurogenic claudication, progressive neurologic deficit) attributable to the level adjacent to the prior fusion
Objective imaging (MRI, CT, or dynamic X‑ray) confirming degenerative change or instability at the adjacent level
Conservative therapy (physical therapy, pain management, etc.) attempted and failed according to the criteria in the referenced procedure‑specific sections

Non-Indications: Prior adjacent‑level lumbar fusion performed less than 6 months before the current request
Failure to satisfy the specific criteria in CMM-609.4 (lumbar fusion with decompression) or CMM-609.5 (lumbar fusion without decompression)
Absence of documented adjacent segment pathology on imaging or clinical examination
Important criteria & exceptions: The 6‑month minimum interval after the initial adjacent‑level fusion is mandatory
All required findings from the procedure‑specific sections (CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5) must be met; no waiver or substitution is permitted
Documentation required: Operative report of the prior adjacent‑level lumbar fusion showing date of surgery
Current lumbar spine MRI, CT, or dynamic flexion‑extension X‑ray demonstrating pathology at the adjacent level
Physician’s clinical note detailing symptoms, neurologic findings, and functional impairment attributable to the adjacent segment
Documentation of completed conservative management (physical therapy notes, medication trials, pain‑management interventions) and duration as required by the referenced procedure‑specific sections
If applicable, operative note or pre‑operative plan for the proposed fusion meeting the criteria of CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5
